newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg plodding its way towards 2.80 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg plodding its way towards 2.80 marks.

text.p: Sterling/mark continues to make rising lows, and should ratchet higher in the short term as it moves gradually towards 2.80, chart watchers said on Friday.
The immediate area to watch is congestion around 2.7915/30 marks, which analysts said should disperse to offer the psychological 2.8000 level and the major 2.8080 above.
The 2.8080 region represents a 78.6 percent Fibonacci retracement of the pound's decline from the May 6 high of 2.8330 marks to the recent low of 2.7240.
Sterling was quoted at 2.7863/73 marks at 0713 GMT compared to 2.7820/30 in late Europe on Thursday.
Analysts said sterling's old floor of 2.7780 marks in the European exchange rate mechanism should provide decent support, with recent lows around 2.7750 cutting in below there.
"If it went through 2.7750 it could look a bit ugly, but provided it stays above that it should stay above 2.80 next week," said Stuart Frost, market analyst at NatWest Markets.
Sterling/dollar continues to drift in an uninspiring range, although chartists said the bias was bullish for choice.
Congestion around $1.6425/50 has blocked the pound for some time, and it must clear that to open $1.6480-90 and the May 21 peak of $1.6598.
Sterling stood at $1.6390/00, unchanged from Thursday's European close.
RSI - 14 day: Stg/mark: 52 pct, Stg/dollar: 52 pct
